properties.name: add_capability draws the golden thread in the call that creates the node
properties.rationale:
hxm_program F-02, taken on Anthony's word 2026-09-10.

⚠️ ONLY HALF OF F-02 WAS BUILT, AND THE OTHER HALF WAS ALREADY FIXED. The report's headline was the duplicate guard refusing every capability written after its requirement, six times in one session. `PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS` landed 2026-08-31 with ("Requirement","Capability") as its FIRST entry and ("Requirement","Decision") beside it, so both cases the report names are exempt and the refusal is gone. Re-fixing it would have changed nothing.

⭐ THIS ANSWERS IDEA ② OF AN OPEN DECISION, `dec:idea-should-a-creation-call-carry-its-own-golden-thread`, and DOES NOT SETTLE IT. That node holds four ideas from proj:bhome — inline project_id (①), inline satisfies (②), a genesis bulk-seed call (③), and quality_target on add_decision (④). Only ② is built, extended with `allocated_to`. The decision stays `proposed` because three of its four ideas are unanswered and only the owner's word moves it.

⭐ ITS COUNTER-ARGUMENT (4) IS NOW A TESTED TRADE RATHER THAN A HYPOTHETICAL. That node warned: "INLINE LINKS MOVE FAILURES EARLIER BUT MAKE THEM COARSER — a typo in one `satisfies` id refuses the capability itself." That is exactly the behaviour built, chosen deliberately over the alternative (write the node, skip the edge, warn), because a capability left carrying half a thread to an id that does not exist is worse than the retry this removes. `a_thread_end_that_names_nothing_is_refused` pins it, including that nothing persists.

PRECEDENT, which is why this was a gap rather than a design question: `add_verification` already takes `verifies`, `add_decision` takes `related_to` and `approver`, `add_change_event` takes `affected` and refuses the whole call on a bad entry, and `link_artifact` creates three things atomically. The busiest constructor on the golden thread took neither of its two edges.

REPAIR DISPOSITION, which could not be recorded on this path: this is `corrected_cause` for the ergonomics half. `repair` lives only on `record_change` and `detected_at` only here, so no single call can carry both — recorded as `fact:record-change-places-an-event-by-epoch-and-212-of-214-epochs-carry-no-date`.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `add_capability` gains `satisfies` (the Requirement it serves) and `allocated_to` (the Component that will provide it); each draws its edge in the same call, so the golden thread costs one call instead of three. An id naming nothing is REFUSED with nothing written — the node is rolled back exactly as the duplicate-guard path already does.
